messages:
Tess (CS): notes from Aurora Analytics onboarding — they love throughput but surfaced 3 renewal-sensitive asks. paste raw.
Marco (CSM): short: finance needs campaign-level cost splits; ops saw duplicate events when client retried; product wants per-route p50/p95. risk=medium-high.
Tess (CS): customer asks:
- campaign tagging (header or metadata) for export
- optional server-side retries with idempotency and DLQ
- per-route latency percentiles in console or CSV
Tess (CS): they supplied this curl snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.aurora.io/ingest -H "X-Campaign: aurora-summit" -H "X-Idempotency: id-77" -d '{"route":"score","uid":42}'
```
Ellen (Eng): quick take: campaign pass-through + include in usage export = ~1 sprint. per-route percentiles reuse metrics pipeline ~1 sprint. retries+idempotency+DLQ = heavier ~2-3 sprints.
Pri (PM): proposal: (1) campaign-export MVP (header passthrough + CSV) (2) per-route pctls (3) server-side retry infra. which is fastest to unblock CFO?
Ellen (Eng): campaign export is fastest. we can accept an `X-RW-Campaign` header and include campaign_name column in exports.
Tess (CS): action: I'll create RW-8342 with acceptance criteria and sample CSV rows. customer asked for export by EOW.
support-bot: created ticket RW-8342 "campaign-export MVP" assigned to Product; https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-8342 :white_check_mark:
Marco (CSM): I'll tell Aurora we can prioritize campaign export this sprint and follow up on retries ETA.
Pri (PM): Ellen — can you add a short tech note on idempotency header format + DLQ semantics in RW-8343 by Thu?
Ellen (Eng): will add note + rough effort estimate.
Tess (CS): closing loop; will post updates after ticket grooming and sprint planning. thanks.
